items.note: N1 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) in three stages and restoring scratch; the method follows the proof (scratch-independent net change, coefficient cancellation, forward/inverse/forward composition). The explicit coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2 and the neighbour rules are only described in words.
N2 gives D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} with edge operator D_v D_u^{-1}, derived by the paper's invariant and the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate (line 812).

Nested nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3}, the only decreasing edges being central 3->4 edges each losing h, and L/N=100/539, 101/539 are all stated. But N3 only claims the total change is 'below W m': the budget Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich and the telescoping at gates that produces it (lines 1066-1071) are missing.

Projection matrices, -P_{U_a} sources, the endpoint identity = I_m and the deficit N-2L_b>0 (so s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b) match the paper. The derivation omits the exceptional source edges: 2P_{U_a} has rank one where the dimension change is zero (lines 1162-1166). Only N3.2's 'extra source ranks' alludes to this, and it is what turns -2N into -N.

Kernels aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c<W_c m, and C^{tensor m} on every role after the C=iZC^{-1}Z fix all follow the proof via additivity of weight mod 4. The statement calls the frames 'i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}', omitting the H^{tensor m} conjugation (line 1193), and gives no formula s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c.

L<N/2, s<Wm for both networks, deficits above 20*2^{-50} and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} are all stated. N6 is a bare inference: the exact eta values and the log m<20 step (lines 1332-1338) are not given.

The operations and their split/merge and cut/re-merge proofs match the paper. T2 drops the hypothesis that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time from a fixed number of controls (lines 566-568), which is the condition the O(V) bound needs.
Gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 by topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination, the conjugation order, and the three-step pivot with one H-D interchange, so exactly a interchanges plus O(V), as in the paper.

Follows the paper's route: cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, an address shear per edge by recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear interchange, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule at O(V) per node.
Uses high digits as a row field of range at least W^k, pads to a multiple of W^k, decomposes the width in base m as a geometric sum, and pads [2^u] to [q^e], as in the proof.

Conjugation by P_M, row additions on whole slots, s_c forward children on e/m axes with inverses via -iZCZ, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D all match. L1's wording 'each of the s_c residual-basis slots' is loose: there are m slots, and an edge uses its first rho_edge slots; s_c is the total number of child calls over the network.

Covers the eight-line parity transposition, simultaneous cyclic shifts, the guard-based bad set with fraction 80(f-1)2^{-K} by a union bound, deterministic repair by radix sort, the final two-bit XOR, and cost O(V(L^tau+1)), all as in the proof.

Node overhead, rows from the first q_0 chunks, the u=Wg+w split and F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) are stated. L2.3 says the recurrence sums to O(e^lambda) and omits the leaf contribution O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), the stop at e<d^beta, K<=e^{c/beta} and the condition lambda'>max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)} (lines 2402-2445).

Covers the H_0 to C conversion, the recursive layer on role-split rows, the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with Delta=o(p), the single final truncation with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, and O(Vd^{lambda'}) cost, matching the proof.

Covers character cancellation by the shift argument, the DIF recursion, bit-reversed storage B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, the layout L by prefix moves and chunk exchanges, the cost terms, and error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} via truncation commuting with J_E.
Evaluates at B_0=2^{4p} with four established-multiplier products, extracts centred residues using |h_j|<B_0/2, reduces negacyclically and truncates, in O(rp log(rp)), as in the proof.
Keeps the LB order, uses commutation of pointwise product with record permutation, scales by M, error budget 3delta+eta times M and the stated cost, as in the proof.

Uses the HvdH Gaussian identity and the Neumann-series left inverse D N^{-1} C to get P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, then tensors it with linewise expansion/compression and O(d^2) adjacent axis interchanges, matching the proofs.
Gives the Bluestein identity by coefficient comparison and R cancellation via F^+_q R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+_q, commutation with pointwise products and the normalized convolution rule, as in the proof.

The exponents, sizes, alpha, gamma=o(b), the prime intervals, gcd, T/2<S<T and the trial-division search all match. eta=1/(4d) is never given, so the prime intervals and the separation condition alpha^4 theta_i>p are left unquantified.
Phi with mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, the isomorphism, the triangular update order i=d..1 by prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) all match. The explicit b_i formula is only paraphrased.
Well-definedness, diagonal isomorphism and the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j follow the paper. The interface identity M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g) is only described in A6.1.
Covers the source transform (A-expansion, chirp, B_0, 2^gamma) with exact counterpart RF_s, the opposite version by conjugation, and the step sequence with the two occurrences of S, as in the paper.

Error propagation through contractions, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, the (3E_s+2) opposite-transform bound, the final bound 448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and the carry invariant all follow the paper. E_ring<5TL and E_w are left implicit.

Normalization by Tp, the table, min g_i=g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, absorption of log factors and the schoolbook cutoff are present. The margin expressions g_1..g_7 (notably g_2=eps c(1-tau)) are not given, and the o(V) bounds for setup and exceptional-stream sorting (lines 4913-4973) are absent.

R only lists 'nlogn-conjecture' among its dependencies and motivates with the n log n scan cost. No step states the liminf criterion or why O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) refutes an eventual n lg n lower bound.

errors.says: apply the f-fold forward child on each of the s_c residual-basis slots
errors.paper: A group has m slots. For one edge, children are applied on slots h=1..rho_edge after conjugation by P_M; s_c is the total number of child calls over the whole network, not a number of slots.

errors.says: with a=s/W<m^lambda the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) sums to O(e^lambda)
errors.paper: Only the internal costs sum to O(e^lambda), and that needs K<=e^{c/beta} and tau(1+c/beta)<lambda. The leaves contribute O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), which is why lambda' must exceed sigma+beta(1-sigma).

errors.says: a target field update y -> y+a(controls) mod Q with the controls earlier on tape costs O(V)
errors.paper: The lemma requires the offset to be preparable in b^{O(1)} time from a fixed number of control values; that cost is absorbed by the Q blocks of the fiber.
The frame is C_U=H^{tensor m} diag_x(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{tensor m}, the diagonal phase conjugated by Hadamards; this conjugation is what turns the phase factors into translation kernels aI+bX_v.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route: scalar exchange network, frames, nested labels with L<N/2, the bit and complex interfaces with s<Wm, tau=1-2^{-50}, then the interchange recurrence, the chunk swap, the simultaneous layer, transforms, resampling/chirp/CRT assembly, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins out at the rank budget, where Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich and the rank-one source exceptions that turn it into s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are only alluded to. It also thins at the layer recurrence, whose leaf term and lambda' condition are omitted, and at the final margins, where g_1..g_7 and the o(V) setup bounds are not spelled out.

steps.note: N1 carries the fixed linear network on banks X,Y sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire, and N3 gives the m-dimensional F^{tensor 3} built from triple indicators. h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated, so this verdict is borderline.
A common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1} and each edge applies D_v D_u^{-1}.
Nested nondegenerate subspaces of the m-dimensional F^{tensor 3}, every edge joining comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges being the central 3->4 edges, each losing h.

N4's method states that edge differences are projections onto residuals whose rank is the dimension change. The N rank-one source exceptions appear only as 'extra source ranks' in N3.2, so this verdict is borderline.
The sum Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich are absent. N3 says only that the total change is below Wm, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b is implicit in N4.1's deficit N-2L_b.
Gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, and the deficit N-2L_b>0.
Gives M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m with the X_a computation P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, and the resulting shear H<-H+D on every row.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so a node makes s recursive calls.
Children have volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits above 20*2^{-50}, giving F_k=O(e^tau). The log m<20 step is not stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs eight of the nine steps of the central saving: network, frames, labels, rank = dimension change, the strict ratio L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The budget identity Wm-2N+2L (with L=Ich) is missing, so the step from the label count to s=Wm-N+2L<Wm is left implicit.
